text: Daniel Keyes's Flowers for Algernon, winner of the Nebula Award for Best Science Fiction Novel in 1966, was banned in Plant City, Florida, in 1976 and in Emporium, Pennsylvania, in 1977. In 1981 it was banned from the Glen Rose (Arkansas) High School library. Explicit, distasteful love scenes were cited among the reasons for opposition. Oberlin (Ohio) High School and Glenrock (Wyoming) High School also challenged the book for its "distasteful love scenes."
